el.Transformo la realidad en otra posibilid: I turn reality into another possibility through images.
el.Soy artista visual y fotógrafa. Construy: I'm a visual artist and photographer. I build images, situations and imaginaries that turn reality into another possibility. I work in portraiture, self-portraiture and staged photography.
el.Necrópolis, una serie que empecé en 2014: Necrópolis, a series I began in 2014 after the sudden death of a young member of my family, is a deeply personal part of my work. Since then my gaze has become more sensitive, and the series stays with me.
